topic: The Big and Little Diomede Islands
title: You Can See Tomorrow From This Alaskan Island
titles: You Can See Tomorrow From This Alaskan Island
Two Islands Only 2.4 Miles Apart With a 21-Hour Time Difference
The Alaskan Island Where You Can Look Into Tomorrow
hook: You can look straight into tomorrow here.

scenes.text: You can look straight into tomorrow here.
These two rocky islands sit right in the Bering Strait.
Little Diomede belongs to the United States.
At their closest points, they are about 2.4 miles apart.
Yet right between them runs the International Date Line.
This creates a massive time warp.
Big Diomede is 21 hours ahead due to locally defined time zones and the International Date Line.
